Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.

Flags the accuracy shortfall against the minimum technical metric as stage-critical
Lists what to close before the gate

observable_success: Connects the notification to a belief process that generates the belief
Models the executed plan as a plan execution that brings about a new world state
Keeps the belief-desire-intention chain between the two phases
prohibited_outcomes: Stops at the intention and never projects results back to RDF

prompt: A coding agent's session just hit its compression trigger for the second time. prohibited_outcomes: Regenerates the whole summary from scratch each cycle

observable_success: Excludes tool definitions from compression

prohibited_outcomes: Summarizes tool schemas

prompt: A team sizes the context budget for Claude (1M-token window) by dividing characters by four, since 'a token is about four characters'. Their knowledge-base dump is 2.5M characters, so they conclude it is 625K tokens and 'fits with room to spare'. A new engineer asks, conceptually, whether that estimate can be trusted. observable_success: Says the 4-chars-per-token estimate undercounts for this tokenizer
Notes 2.5M characters is about 1M tokens, so it does not fit with room to spare

prohibited_outcomes: Endorses 625K tokens as the size

prompt: An agent platform sends 55 tool definitions with every request. Several overlap (get_user, fetch_user, lookup_user_profile) and most descriptions are a terse line like 'gets user'. prohibited_outcomes: Says tool definitions are free

prompt: A code-review agent works on a 45K-token diff. Current context usage is 52K tokens, the measured safe limit for this model and workload is 90K, and the window is 128K. An architect wants to split the review across 8 sub-agents 'because smaller contexts are always better'. Each sub-agent would need the 7K-token system prompt plus 6K of tool definitions, and a coordinator must aggregate results. Decide whether to partition. Give optimization policy only. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Does not partition because usage is below the measured safe limit
Notes per-sub-agent system prompt and tool overhead (8 x 13K = 104K) exceeds the savings
Says to estimate total tokens before partitioning
prohibited_outcomes: Approves 8-way split on principle
Ignores coordinator and duplicated prompt overhead

checks.name: c1
checks.value: (?i)(overhead|duplicat\w+|repeat\w*.{0,30}(system prompt|tool def)|each sub-?agent.{0,80}(system prompt|tool definitions?)|(system prompt|tool definitions?).{0,80}each sub-?agent)

checks.name: c2
checks.value: (?i)((never|not|don'?t|do not|leave|keep|avoid|shouldn'?t|no|reject|decline)\W.{0,60}(compress|summariz|shorten|shrink|touch|change|alter|rewrit)\w*.{0,40}system prompt|system prompt.{0,100}(unchanged|as is|intact|left alone|alone|stays?|stable|never be (compress|summari)|not be (compress|summari)|do not (compress|summari)|must not))

checks.value: (?is)(?:retry|recall|revision|round|attempt|iteration)s?[^\n]{0,40}(?:cap|limit|max|at most|up to|no more than)|(?:cap|limit|max(?:imum)?|at most|up to|no more than)[^\n]{0,40}(?:retr\w+|recall\w*|revision\w*|round\w*|attempt\w*|iteration\w*)
